 Serie A official line-ups: Udinese vs. Roma 
 By Susy Campanale 
 Oct 31, 2026 16:01 
 ROME, ITALY - OCTOBER 27: Donyell Malen of AS Roma celebrates scoring his team’s fourth goal during the Serie A match between AS Roma and Cagliari Calcio at Stadio Olimpico on October 27, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images) 
 Roma bring Rodrigo Mora and Matias Soulé into the starting XI behind Donyell Malen, as Udinese hope Nicolò Zaniolo and Keinan Davis can dig them out of a crisis.
 It kicks off at the Bluenergy Stadium in Udine at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET).

 You can follow all the build-up and action as it happens from this game, Bologna-Monza and Milan-Inter on the Serie A Liveblog. 
 ROME, ITALY – OCTOBER 27: Gian Piero Gasperini, Manager of AS Roma, looks on before the Serie A match between AS Roma and Cagliari Calcio at Stadio Olimpico on October 27, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images) The Giallorossi need a win to keep up with the joint leaders Inter and Lazio, as after three draws in four league games, they got back on track with a hard-fought 4-2 victory over Cagliari. 
 Paulo Dybala, Mile Svilar, Manu Koné and Lorenzo Pellegrini are still out of action, while Gianluca Mancini is rested ahead of the Champions League clash with Manchester United.
 Rodrigo Mora is rewarded with a rare start, partnering Soulé in support of top scorer Malen.
 Evan Ndicka, Marten de Roon and Nahuel Molina however get no time off to prepare for Old Trafford on Tuesday.
 ROME, ITALY – AUGUST 24: Rodrigo Mora Carvlho of AS Roma reacts during the Serie A match between AS Roma and ACF Fiorentina at Stadio Olimpico on August 24, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images) Udinese ended their run of six consecutive defeats with a 0-0 draw at Parma midweek, where Maduka Okoye saved the Adrian Bernabé penalty.
 Coach Kosta Runjaic is hanging by a thread, but also has a huge injury crisis to deal with, as Oumar Solet, David Alaba, Alessandro Zanoli, Idrissa Gueye and Vakoun Bayo remain on the treatment table.
 Zaniolo faces his former club, having left Roma in bitter circumstances, with Jurgen Ekkelenkamp and Davis upfront.
 Lennon Miller is preferred to Jakub Piotrowski in midfield.
 UDINE, ITALY – APRIL 18: Nicolò Zaniolo of Udinese looks on during the warm up ahead of the Serie A match between Udinese Calcio and Parma Calcio 1913 at Stadio Friuli on April 18, 2026 in Udine, Italy. (Photo by Timothy Rogers/Getty Images) Udinese vs. Roma line-ups 
 Udinese: Okoye; Abankwah, Kabasele, Palma; Vojvoda, Karlstrom, Miller, Kamara; Zaniolo, Ekkelenkamp, Davis
 Roma: Gollini; Ghilardi, Ndicka, Hermoso; Molina, Cristante, De Roon, Wesley: Soulè, Mora; Malen
